caption:
Nigeria moves to clear export and trade barriers to use AfCFTA, Oyedele says

Taiwo Oyedele · Economy

The minister named financing, logistics, certification and bureaucratic barriers as constraints on export competitiveness. Finance Minister and Coordinating Minister of the Economy Taiwo Oyedele said the federal government is moving to dismantle barriers constraining the country's export competitiveness. The government is seeking to position domestic businesses to take advantage of the African Continental Free Trade Area.

Reported by AllAfrica.
